offers.title: Pathway to Aesthetics
offers.label: Three day programme
offers.lead: Build your understanding of aesthetic treatments, consultation and safe practice through focused theory and supervised practical learning in London.
offers.intro: A structured three day programme bringing anatomy, treatment selection and core aesthetics topics together, with consultation, consent and aftercare throughout.
groups: Anatomy & Physiology
Build foundational understanding of skin, facial anatomy and the structures relevant to aesthetic practice. Connect this knowledge with consultation, suitability and safe treatment planning.
Microneedling
Explore skin assessment, contraindications, equipment and cartridge considerations, microneedling principles, aftercare and supervised practical learning.
Chemical Peels
Understand peel types and depth, skin preparation, consultation, contraindications, treatment principles, aftercare and recognising potential complications.
Mesotherapy
Learn skin assessment, mesotherapy principles, patient suitability, product-specific considerations, safe working and aftercare.
Skin Boosters & Polynucleotides
Explore the principles behind these treatment categories, relevant anatomy, consultation, product differences, suitability, treatment planning and aftercare.
Foundation Anti-Wrinkle Treatments
Study facial assessment and anatomy, botulinum toxin principles, contraindications, complications awareness and the importance of appropriate prescribing arrangements and professional scope.
Foundation Dermal Fillers
Explore facial assessment, filler principles, patient selection, treatment planning, anatomical risk awareness and supervised practical learning.
Additional programme learning

Profhilo, Lumi Eyes, filler dissolving and complication management are included in the programme content, alongside exosome theory. Practical participation follows your eligibility and the programme arrangements.
offers.note: Anatomy and physiology content does not establish a formal Level 3 qualification. The programme has its own timetable, assessment and certificate requirements.
offers.related: The Wellness Injection Masterclass is a separate one day programme covering phlebotomy, IV therapy, IM vitamin injections and PRP.

offers.title: Wellness Injection Masterclass
offers.label: One day masterclass
offers.lead: Bring phlebotomy, IV therapy, IM vitamin injections and PRP together in one focused day of theory and supervised practical learning.
offers.intro: Explore the assessment, preparation and safety principles behind four clinical skill areas, alongside consent, documentation and aftercare.
groups: Phlebotomy

Learn patient identification, preparation and consent, vein selection and blood collection principles, safe sample handling, labelling, infection prevention and sharps safety. Connect blood collection with the preparation stages used in PRP.
IV Drip Therapy

Explore patient assessment, suitability and contraindications, IV cannulation, infusion preparation and administration principles, observation and monitoring, recognising complications, escalation and aftercare.
IM Vitamin Injections

Understand clinical indications and suitability, vitamin selection principles, injection-site assessment, preparation and administration principles, medicine and prescribing requirements, infection prevention, records and aftercare.
Platelet-Rich Plasma (PRP)

Understand how PRP is prepared from a patient’s blood. Study preparation and centrifugation, equipment-specific principles, patient and treatment selection, consent, complication awareness and aftercare. PRF and exosomes are separate subjects.
Skills that connect all four subjects
Patient consultation, medical history, informed consent, documentation, infection prevention, recognising complications and safe clinical judgement run throughout the masterclass.
offers.note: The combined masterclass has its own timetable, practical scope, assessment and certificate requirements. It does not automatically include the full hours or awards of separate activities.
offers.related: Pathway to Aesthetics is a separate three day programme.

offers.title: Regenerative Medicine Masterclass
offers.label: Regenerative masterclass
offers.lead: PRP, PRF and exosome science with safe professional practice throughout.
offers.note: Exosome practical administration is not promised unless an exact product and approved protocol are confirmed.

offers.title: Collagen Biostimulators Masterclass
offers.label: Liquid Face Lift masterclass
offers.lead: Sculptra, Olidia and Radiesse with product science, assessment and treatment planning.
offers.note: The course title does not promise a surgical-equivalent facelift result.
